provenance.name: anchored-v7
provenance.note: Anchoring to the published results of another machine with what the first washes on the owner's machine fixed held in place (round robin 2022/2023, Bosch SMV6ECX51E, eco programme, detergent D; docs/research/standards.md section 7.1), to be replaced by more washes on the owner's machine. Made on the water side "spotless-sim 0.5.0 water-7", sources sha256:325c9602e38528c76d71eaf5fd2d7f1d187015b9b6ea948d2426c97bf07ed0e0; valid for that water side only (anchors/scripts/check.ts). Reference detergent D at 20 g. soil.egg_yolk.rateRef (and soil.milk.rateRef with it) fitted to the six in-machine egg-yolk rates; the lags read off the same bench data; liq.xProtease fitted to the cutlery and glass class means and soil.bleachRate to the crockery class mean of the record, each through the calibration tool's likelihood of a group mean score. Held at values a wash of the owner's machine fixed (owner-wash-01-egg-yolk-eco50: prog.soakDuty): prog.soakDuty = 0.8; the three fits were made with them in place. Everything else is the registry's default. soil.bleachRate is kept by the floor rule: at its default every iec_tea item reads dirty, which caps the crockery mean at 3.12 against the published 3.68; the record bounds it from below only (off the floor from 0.0009). See docs/calibration/anchoring-v7.md.

reference.digestNote: Digest recorded again on 2026-10-11 without a fit: since that day a wash lays what the water left standing in an item held onto the surface under it (residue left where dirty water stood), and the digest covers the residue of every item. In this reference wash four mugs hold 0.08 to 0.09 mL in a base recess and carry 0.017 to 0.020 mg of it, none of it visible; with that taken out again the digest is the one recorded at the fit (bf2fe323c9f02639a27b3fda5f84cb8cbc6ff6bd7eaef10b150e9049c1a09f78): every verdict, score, own residue and pooled volume is unchanged.
